unknown_noise_joint_inference.method: candidate posterior plus candidate-specific Beta(1,9) observation-error posterior; true bit-flip rate is not supplied
unknown_noise_joint_inference.conservative_threshold_control: raising threshold to 0.9999 removed observed wrong routing at 30% noise in the matched screen, at the cost of much higher unresolved rate

source_pool_scaling.family: continuous 2D linear directions with four positive-scale/offset gauge variants per direction
source_pool_scaling.relation: two-output order bit, invariant to positive scale+offset
source_pool_scaling.interpretation: relation query complexity tracks the number of behavioral equivalence classes, while residual gauge fixing cost stays constant at log2(4)=2 bits

current_hypothesis: universal source identification should maximize gauge-invariant behavior, infer the residual equivalence class, and spend grounding bits only on the remaining automorphism/gauge; query complexity is governed more directly by behavioral class entropy than raw source count
claim_boundaries: continuous experiments use synthetic scalar functions and known input generators
order relations are invariant to strictly increasing output reparameterizations, not arbitrary output bijections
cross-modal scalar/reference predicates are real grounding channels
noise screens assume deterministic candidate characterization; unknown-noise inference still uses a low-noise Beta prior
